title: Use the title architect only when registered
what: Present oneself as a registered architect, or advertise architectural services, only if registered.

sources.title: Architects Act 2004 (ACT)
sources.locator: s 57(1) (current republication (R18, from 16 November 2025; Architects Act 2004 | Acts))
sources.quote: An individual must not pretend to be registered

sources.title: Architects Act 2004 (ACT)
sources.locator: s 59(1) (current republication (R18, from 16 November 2025; Architects Act 2004 | Acts))
sources.quote: An individual commits an offence if— (a) the individual advertises that the individual provides, or will provide, an architectural service; and (b) the individual is not registered

sources.title: Architects Act 2004 (ACT)
sources.locator: s 9, words naming the body (found 18 Nov 2026) (current republication (R18, from 16 November 2025; Architects Act 2004 | Acts)
sources.quote: the architects board must register, or refuse to register, the individual.
